v1.51.1a (1 February 2025) |feed_title = 🧨 Lunar New Year 🧨 |feed_color = Beige |previous_update = [[v1.50.0]] |next_update = [[v1.52.0]] }} ==Description== '''v1.51.0''' is the one hundred and fourth update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 29th of January 2025. It added both the [[Rocketeer]] rework and the [[Lunar Crate]]. This update contains four updates, the main v1.51.0 (released 29 January 2025) and three minor updates, the v1.51.0a (released 30 January 2025), v1.51.1 (released 31 January 2025) and v1.51.1a (released 1 February 2025). ==Additions== ===Crates=== *[[Lunar Crate]] **Contains three skins: ***{{Color|LunarYear|Lunar}} [[Rocketeer]] ***{{Color|LunarYear|Lunar}} [[Hallow Punk]] ***{{Color|LunarYear|Lunar}} [[Harvester]] ===Nametags=== *[[Lunar Nametag]] ==Changes & Bugfixes== ===Towers=== *[[Rocketeer]] reworked. **Updated accuracy, now accuracy of projectiles can be altered through upgrades. **Now can fire out multiple rockets at once. Each rocket targets a different enemy in the spread angle of the [[Rocketeer]], though if there is less enemies than missiles, multiple missiles will target the same enemy. **Damage update, now can generate fireworks. **Statistical Changes: ***'''Level 2''' ****Renamed from ''Direct Hit'' to ''Heavier Payload''. ***'''Level 4''' ****Cost decreased from {{Money|20,000}} to {{Money|18,500}}. ****Damage decreased from +250 to -60. ****Range increased from +3 to +5. ****Explosion Range increased from 4 to 4 > 5. ****Missile Count increased from +0 to +3. ****Renamed from ''Artillery Cannon'' to ''Missile Maelstrom''. *{{Color|Lunar|Masquerade}} [[Medic]] skin appearance changed. *[[Harvester]] and its {{Color|LunarYear|Lunar}} skin are now available through a limited time gamepass for {{Robux|799}}. *[[Hallow Punk]] and its {{Color|LunarYear|Lunar}} skin are now available through a limited time gamepass for {{Robux|399}}. *[[Archer]] gamepass taken offsale. :In '''v1.51.1a''': *[[Harvester]] gamepass taken offsale. *[[Hallow Punk]] gamepass taken offsale. ===Enemies=== *[[Quick]]'s cash given is now mode dependent. **{{Money|8}} on death in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode and [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. **{{Money|10}} on death in [[Pizza Party]]. **{{Money|5}} on death if no value is set for the mode. *[[Scout (Pizza Party)|Scout]] cash given increased from {{Money|400}} to {{Money|500}} upon death. *[[Breaker2]] cash given is now mode dependent. **{{Money|25}} on death in [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode, [[Casual Mode|Casual]] mode, [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode, [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode and [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. **{{Money|100}} on death in [[Pizza Party]]. **{{Money|5}} on death if no value is set. *[[Citizen
